channel.title: govbot — CPS Board of Education: candidates on upcoming ballots
channel.description: All CPS Board of Education races govbot is tracking on upcoming Chicago/Illinois ballots, refreshed twice daily.

item.title: CPS Board President
item.description: On the ballot 2026-11-03. No candidates confirmed yet. The Chicago Board of Education's first voter-elected president. Chicago is moving from a mayor-appointed board to a fully elected 21-member board; the president is elected citywide for the first time on Nov 3, 2026.

item.title: CPS Board Member — Subdistrict 1A
item.description: On the ballot 2026-11-03. No candidates confirmed yet. A Chicago Board of Education subdistrict seat. As the hybrid appointed/elected board phases out, these subdistrict seats are filled by voters. Some districts elected a member in 2024 and others were mayor-appointed — the 2026 election is part of completing the fully elected board.
